tagline: STIHL dealer and service workshop in Hamilton
heroSubheading: We sell STIHL equipment, service what you buy, and stock all the parts you need
aboutHtml:
We're Onkar and Sukhdeep Singh, and we run STIHL SHOP Te Rapa here in Hamilton. We set this place up to give locals access to the STIHL equipment they need, and to have someone they trust to service it properly when they need repairs or maintenance.

We stock a full range of STIHL equipment, from chainsaws and brushcutters to hedge trimmers and blowers. We service and repair STIHL gear and keep parts in stock. Whatever you're doing, whether it's clearing land, mowing or property work, we've got what you need.

Come in and talk to us. We're open seven days a week to help you find the right gear for your place and to keep everything running when you need it.
whatMakesUsSpecial: We stock everything STIHL in one place
